title: Remove deprecated gate command aliases (pass/pass-all/check/check-all)
description:
Follow-up to 949cd9d0, which renames the gate verbs to `evaluate`/`status` while retaining the legacy names `pass`, `pass-all`, `check`, `check-all` as silent aliases so no caller breaks at rename time.

This issue performs the one breaking change: dropping those four aliases once the new names have settled. It is a direct dependency of the 1.0 milestone so the CLI ships 1.0 with a single, truthful gate-verb surface.

Concentrating the removal here keeps 949cd9d0 non-breaking and does all the alias-removal churn (CLI, MCP tool schema, in-repo docs) in one place.

## Success Criteria
- [hard] REQ-01: the gate subcommand aliases `pass`, `pass-all`, `check`, and `check-all` are removed; invoking any of them fails with clap's standard unknown-subcommand error.
- [hard] REQ-02: only the canonical verbs `evaluate`/`eval`, `evaluate-all`, `status`, `status-all`, and `fail` remain on the write/read surface; help lists no removed alias.
- [hard] REQ-03: in-repo references to the removed aliases (docs under `docs/`, `dev/`, and any product help text) are swept to the canonical names.
- [hard] REQ-04: the MCP tool schema exposes no `gate_pass`/`gate_pass_all`/`gate_check`/`gate_check_all` tools; regenerated tools use the canonical names only.
